prompts.title: Aqua Atrium
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Backrooms game level environment concept art, one standalone widescreen image, no panels.
Primary request: Design an eerily empty Frutiger Aero Backrooms level called Aqua Atrium, an endless aquatic shopping-mall concourse circa 2004.
Scene: human-scale white tiled pedestrian promenade passes a huge curving aquarium wall, clear turquoise water channels, rounded blue-green glass railings, immaculate grass islands and indoor palms. Identical unoccupied storefront openings and escalators repeat into an impossibly long distance. A second balcony crosses overhead; a single unlit passage interrupts the perfection. Clearly show a usable walking route into the depth of the maze.
Style: beautifully polished architectural game concept render with the sincere early-2000s Frutiger Aero desktop-wallpaper aesthetic: aquatic cyan, saturated fresh lime greenery, glossy translucent plastics, bubbly curved glazing, sky and water optimism made uncanny by complete vacancy. Believable modular architecture, quiet liminal-space photography sensibility.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, eye-level 24mm lens, off-center foreground glass curves lead to deep layered corridors, strong readable architecture, high detail.
Lighting: luminous overcast skylight, water caustics across white walls, cool fluorescent recesses, gentle blue distance haze, subtly unsettling stillness.
Constraints: zero people or creatures, no text, no titles, no logos, no watermark, no UI. No grunge or decay, no cyberpunk, no purple neon. This must feel like a familiar vacant 2000s public interior, not a spaceship.

prompts.title: Cloud Terminal
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Backrooms game level environment concept art, one standalone widescreen image, no panels.
Primary request: Create Cloud Terminal, an eerie Frutiger Aero Backrooms level based on an empty early-2000s airport terminal that appears to float inside an impossibly perfect desktop-wallpaper sky.
Scene: long straight carpeted terminal concourse, repetitive white rounded structural ribs, glass-blue moving walkways and rows of empty translucent cobalt molded-plastic seats. Broad window bays display a brilliant azure sky with puffy white clouds and intensely green rolling hills, yet a faint vertical seam and repeating cloud pattern imply it may be a giant artificial panorama. A few compact circular grass planters. Identical branching gate corridors vanish into the distance, all unoccupied. One far passage loses its lights. Broad clear pedestrian path.
Style: high-quality architectural game concept render, early-2000s Frutiger Aero aesthetic; optimistic clean consumer-tech forms, chrome, glossy icy blue glass and tiny lime accents; uncanny institutional emptiness and spatial repetition.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9 at normal player eye level, long asymmetrical vanishing point, nearest blue seats large enough to establish human scale, sky windows occupy one side, the terminal remains visibly an interior.
Lighting: beautiful saturated sky blue sunlight, soft clean reflections, fluorescent ceiling panels, unsettlingly uniform perfection.
Constraints: no people, no monsters, no airplanes, no legible signs or text, no watermark, no logos or UI. No sci-fi spaceship, no neon cyberpunk, no grime or ruin. Visually distinct from an aquatic mall; no pools.

prompts.title: Evergreen Office
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Backrooms game level environment concept art, one standalone widescreen image, no panels.
Primary request: Create Evergreen Office, a beautiful but unsettling Frutiger Aero Backrooms office labyrinth from around 2003.
Scene: a low suspended acoustic-tile ceiling stretches across an impossibly large corporate office. Waist-high translucent apple-green and aqua cubicle dividers surround identical white curved desks with chunky translucent blue rounded desktop computer monitors and unoccupied ergonomic chairs. The anonymous monitors show simple abstract blue-green gradients, without text or logos. Broad pale carpet walkways form looping repeating lanes. Small pristine rectangular grass courtyards and fern beds occur indoors behind clear glass; full-height partitions show serene cloud and green-hill murals. A central doorway repeats through several rooms; one distant aisle is gently dimmer. Keep believable ordinary office construction and visible walkable routes.
Style: sophisticated environment concept render with liminal-space photographic realism; unmistakable sincere early-2000s Frutiger Aero optimism, glossy translucent plastic, water-drop-inspired hardware, fresh green nature and friendly technology, with tension from sterile repetition and vacancy.
Composition: landscape 16:9, human eye level, close cubicle corner foreground, repeating desks recede diagonally, strong sense of playable enclosed maze. Less monumental than the other concepts, intimate and maze-like.
Lighting: cool diffuse fluorescent ceiling grid mixed with artificial sunny murals; very clean cyan shadows and pale green reflections.
Constraints: nobody present, no entity, no text or titles, no logos, no watermark, no UI; no dilapidation, no cyberpunk neon, no spaceship architecture. Not an open atrium or pool.

prompts.title: Blue Current Baths
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Backrooms game level environment concept art, one standalone widescreen image, no panels.
Primary request: Create Blue Current Baths, an uncanny Frutiger Aero Backrooms pool labyrinth inside an immaculate 2000s indoor leisure center.
Scene: rounded white and pale-aqua ceramic tiled walls form a maze of low archways and branching pool rooms. Shallow crystal turquoise pools are separated by generous dry tiled walking ledges with rounded stainless handrails. Large thick circular blue glass portholes in some walls reveal impossibly deep blue water and soft rising bubbles, despite rooms on both sides. Pale lime glass-block accent walls, a few translucent blue molded loungers, one small fern planter. Repeating arches and a stripe of rich cobalt mosaic guide the eye deep into a silent shadowed side corridor. Ceiling remains an ordinary enclosed pool-building ceiling with frosted daylight panels. Show clean navigable floor and stairs for human scale.
Style: premium cinematic architectural concept render, Frutiger Aero glossy 2000s aquatic design language with translucent blues, bubble motifs and pristine hopeful surfaces, eerie Backrooms spatial repetition. Clean and strangely inviting, subtly claustrophobic.
Composition: landscape 16:9, eye-level view at the junction of two pool corridors, strong foreground water caustics, off-center curving dry walkway leading into several rooms, highly readable geometry.
Lighting: luminous cyan water reflections, softly glowing frosted skylights, cobalt depth in circular water windows, no dramatic horror spotlight.
Constraints: no people, no creatures, no words or titles, no logos, no UI, no watermark. No decay or dirt, no purple neon, no industrial pipes, no science-fiction spaceship. Distinct intimate enclosed poolroom maze, not a mall.
